'''Brazoria Interconnector Gas Pipeline (BIG)''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/contracts-and-tenders/23012015/Spectra-Energy-to-acquire-Brazoria-Interconnector-Gas-Pipeline-69/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Stratton Ridge, Texas to Iowa Colony, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/contracts-and-tenders/23012015/Spectra-Energy-to-acquire-Brazoria-Interconnector-Gas-Pipeline-69/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
